# Cross-repo interop

This repo takes part in a shared layer across `~/Desktop/Code`: a
portfolio index, corpus projections, per-consumer MCP surfaces, and
rules about what may cross between repos and how.

**The brief and the conventions are in `portfolio-commons`**, which is
private — they name clients, employers and personal material, so the
content is not reproduced in a public repo.

```
~/Desktop/Code/portfolio-commons/BRIEF.md         why it is shaped this way
~/Desktop/Code/portfolio-commons/CONVENTIONS.md   the rules themselves
commons doctor                                    what is stale or missing
```
